clinics.name: Dr. Cinik Hair Transplant & Plastic Surgery (Dr. Muhammet Emrah Cinik)
clinics.namedDoctors: Dr. Muhammet Emrah Cinik is listed as founder and lead hair transplant surgeon; Eda Cinik is medical director. Other physicians appear by first name only (Dr. Servet, Dr. Ertan, Dr. Eser, Dr. Erol, Dr. Mahmut) with no specialty or registration details. The site does not state whether Dr. Cinik personally performs extraction, channel opening or implantation, or whether technicians perform some steps. No ISHRS membership is claimed on the site and no listing for him was found in the ISHRS directory (October 2026). Anesthesiologist not named.
clinics.credentials: On the Ministry of Health authorized-facility list (October 2026) as 'Özel Dr. Cinik Tıp Merkezi' (Gayrettepe Mah. Mevlüt Pehlivan Cad. No:23, Şişli); a second entry 'Özel Cinik Polikliniği' in Beşiktaş is also listed. The clinic site gives Fulya, Mevlüt Pehlivan Sk. No:19. No accreditation named on the site; it shows unlabelled award logos and claims '15+ years'. Year founded not stated.
clinics.cautions: In July 2025 a 38-year-old British patient, Martyn Latchman, died after falling ill at the Dr. Cinik clinic in Beşiktaş while being prepared for a second hair transplant; the clinic said pre-operative tests were done under an anesthesiologist and that he became unwell before the procedure began. The Istanbul provincial health directorate opened an investigation and the body went to the Council of Forensic Medicine; no cause of death or inquest outcome had been published as of October 2026 (cinik-press-turkishminute, cinik-press-lbc). The site does not say who performs each surgical step.
clinics.publishedPrices: Not published on its site. The site says quotes are personalised after a free consultation and graft analysis (October 2026).

booking.channels: WhatsApp and phone +90 549 641 37 01; email info@drcinik.com; booking page https://drcinik.com/book; request form on the home page.
booking.consult: Free online consultation; a patient coordinator replies after the form is submitted and a graft analysis is made from photos. Response time, fee and deposit terms are not published.
booking.languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Arabic site versions.
booking.includes: All-inclusive package described as procedure, medications, aftercare, hotel and VIP airport transfers.

The site states an International Health Tourism Authorization Certificate and a HealthTürkiye listing (not independently verified). Year founded not stated.

clinics.name: AHD Clinic (Dr. Hakan Doğanay)
clinics.namedDoctors: Dr. Hakan Doğanay, founder, experience 'starting back in 2003'; no medical specialty or degree stated. The prices page is explicit: in the 'Dr. Doğanay plan' he does the consultation and hairline design, 'FUE extraction by AHD technicians, supervised by Dr. Doğanay', and implantation 'performed solely by Dr. Doğanay himself'; in the cheaper 'AHD Team' packages both FUE extraction and DHI implantation are done by technicians under his supervision. The site shows ISHRS, AHLA and IAHRS logos; the American Hair Loss Association lists him as a recommended surgeon; no listing was found in the ISHRS find-a-doctor directory (October 2026). Anesthesiologist not named.
clinics.credentials: On the Ministry of Health authorized-facility list (October 2026) as 'Özel AHD Polikliniği' (Güzeloba Mah. Rauf Denktaş Cad. No:4/101-102, Muratpaşa), matching the address on the clinic's prices page. The site claims Ministry of Health licensing with regular inspections; no licence number given. Founded 2003 per the site.
clinics.cautions: Technicians perform extraction in every plan and also implantation in the standard packages; only the per-graft plan has the doctor implanting (ahd-prices). Turkey's hair-transplant unit regulation sets a transition period for assistant staff to 31 December 2026 and a national standard for non-physician assistant practitioners took effect 9 February 2026 (tr-hair-regulation-2026).
clinics.publishedPrices: On the clinic prices page (seen October 2026): Dr. Doğanay plan EUR 3 per graft (about $3.45, EUR 1 = $1.15 approximate rate, October 2026); AHD Team packages EUR 3,300 up to 2,500 grafts (about $3,795), EUR 3,300 to 4,000 for 2,500 to 4,000 grafts (about $3,795 to $4,600), EUR 4,000 to 4,500 for 4,000 to 6,000 grafts (about $4,600 to $5,175). Transport, accommodation and medical kit stated as free. Credit card and cash accepted.

booking.channels: WhatsApp and phone +90 533 154 18 58; contact form https://www.ahdclinic.com/contact/; no email published.
booking.consult: Free consultation from photos; the site says it evaluates suitability and may decline unsuitable patients. Response time and deposit terms not published.
booking.includes: Airport, hotel and clinic transfers, accommodation, post-op medical kit, WhatsApp aftercare.

clinics.name: Elithair (Dr. Abdulaziz Balwi)

The site says 'over 20 highly qualified surgeons' work on site, that team members are each 'specialized in a single step' and that a senior surgeon supervises each step; it does not state which steps doctors perform and which technicians perform. clinics.credentials: On the Ministry of Health authorized-facility list (October 2026) as 'Özel Elit Klinik Tıp Merkezi' (Hamidiye Mah. Cendere Cad. No:103/3-1, Kağıthane), matching the Cendere Cad. Year founded not stated; the site claims over 150,000 patients.
clinics.cautions: High-volume model: more than 300 staff on site and procedures split into single steps per team member, with the doctor-versus-technician split not stated on the site (elithair-clinic). clinics.publishedPrices: On the clinic site (seen October 2026): 'Elithair All-Inclusive' from $3,899, with the site comparing other Turkish clinics at $3,799 to $4,199 and 'budget clinics' at $1,599 to $2,299. Final price depends on graft count.

booking.includes: DHI or NEO FUE, 'Sleep-Deep' anesthesia, six pre-tests, VIP transfers, accommodation (site says both 3 nights in a 4-star hotel and rooms inside the clinic), aftercare kit, one PRP session, medication, app.

clinics.name: Clinic Mono (medical tourism agency, İzmir)
specialties: Gastric sleeve and bypass arranged through contracted surgeons
clinics.namedDoctors: Clinic Mono describes itself as an authorized health tourism agency and lists 'doctors and surgeons we cooperate with': M.D. Eren Ersöz, M.D. Deniz Yıldırım, Assoc. Prof. Dr. Çağlar Ertekin, M.D. Alper Temiz, M.D. Nazmi Yoğurtçu, M.D. Ergin Erdoğan, M.D. Serbay Gürel and dentists Çağrı Dereli and Burak Anıl Sarp. The site does not say which of these performs bariatric surgery or in which hospital. It states Turkish Board and European Board plastic surgery certification badges without tying them to a named surgeon.
clinics.credentials: Not matched by brand name or address on the Ministry list (October 2026); ask the clinic for its legal entity name. The Folkart Towers address is not on the facility list (only unrelated private practices in the same towers appear); as an intermediary agency it would fall under the USHAŞ/TÜRSAB health-tourism intermediary authorization, which the site cites as 'Ministry of Health 11898 International Health Tourism Accredited' (not verified). The operating hospital for bariatric surgery is not named, so its Ministry status could not be checked.
clinics.cautions: This is an agency, not a licensed facility: surgeries are performed by contracted surgeons in hospitals the site does not name. In 2020 a UK patient, Abimbola Bamgbose, died after a package booked through Mono Cosmetic Surgery in İzmir; a newspaper correction stated the surgery was not performed by Mono itself and the family's lawyers alleged negligence (mono-press-jep, mono-press-thecable). Trustpilot showed the company's rating as unavailable for breaching guidelines (October 2026).
clinics.publishedPrices: Not published on its site; the site says it builds tailored all-inclusive packages (October 2026).
